title.en: Resume the exact signed-in vocabulary practice position
title.zh: 准确恢复登录用户词汇练习位置

purpose.en: Close the production persistence gap confirmed after v28: learned-word progress survived, but refreshing reset the learner's visible 20-card round to position 1.
purpose.zh: 修复 v28 后确认的生产持久化缺口：已学词进度能够保留，但刷新会把可见的 20 词轮次重置到第 1 张。

en: Store each signed-in learner's date-scoped 20-card course vocabulary deck and current position in D1.
Advance the server checkpoint only after the sentence step's explicit Continue action.
Restore the same card and visible position after refresh while keeping Repeat After Me off by default.
zh: 在 D1 中保存每位登录学员按本地日期划分的 20 词课程牌组及当前位置。
仅在组句步骤明确点击继续后推进服务器断点。
刷新后恢复同一词卡及可见序号，同时保持跟读默认关闭。

en: Signed-in course vocabulary deck and position persistence; no Clerk, payment, administrator, sibling-site, or anonymous-cookie behavior.
zh: 登录课程词汇牌组及位置持久化；不影响 Clerk、支付、管理员、兄弟站点或匿名 Cookie 行为。

en: Add a constrained, user/path/local-date-unique vocabulary practice session table.
Reuse the persisted daily deck and return its server-authoritative current position on each load.
Add a minimal authenticated advance operation and make the client wait for its database acknowledgement before moving.
zh: 新增受约束且按用户、路径、本地日期唯一的词汇练习会话表。
每次加载复用已保存的当天牌组，并返回服务器权威当前位置。
新增最小化登录推进操作，客户端收到数据库确认后才进入下一张。

en: Run focused persistence contracts, TypeScript, the complete automated suite, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, production-equivalent build, changed-file lint, and shared portfolio gates.
Deploy migration 0168 only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then repeat the ordinary test learner's answer, feedback, Continue, sentence, next-card, refresh, and exact-position path.
zh: 执行持久化定向合同、TypeScript、全量自动化、D1 迁移、敏感数据扫描、生产等价构建、修改文件 lint 与共享组合门禁。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 向 Cloudflare 发布迁移 0168，再复测普通测试学员的答题、反馈、继续、组句、下一张、刷新及准确位置。

en: The remaining en/ja/es/it real-learning matrix and observable normal-versus-slow audio timing require the fresh Terra production retest after this deployment.
zh: 剩余英/日/西/意真实学习矩阵及可观察的正常/慢速音频时长，需要在本次发布后由 Terra 重新执行生产验收。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's existing database authority, Repeat After Me default-off behavior, GitHub-to-Cloudflare delivery, and SmartLingo-only data boundaries.
Do not modify any other site, account, credential, payment rail, database binding, or cloud resource.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 既有数据库权威、跟读默认关闭、GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布及仅限 SmartLingo 的数据边界。
不修改其他站点、账户、凭据、支付通道、数据库绑定或云资源。
